newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products gain, fuel oil barges by $2.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products gain, fuel oil barges by $2.

text.p: NWE oil products were firmer on Friday morning, fuel oil by around $2, dealers said.
High sulphur fuel oil barges traded as high as $83 fob Rotterdam and $84 fob Antwerp with a number of buyers coming forward.
Traders disagreed about the level of bunker enquiries. Some said a large number of enquiries were propping up the barge market: others said there was barely any bunker demand.
Heating oil barges were up almost $1 a tonne as IPE futures strengthened. Offers were at least IPE May +$1 for prompt and first half May.
